About the Role

As the Data Strategy and Operations Manager at Abnormal AI, you will own our go-to-market data quality strategy and serve as the steward of data across Salesforce and the systems around it. You will design the processes, controls, and intelligent workflows that keep data accurate, enriched, and trusted at scale, so Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance can give executive leadership reliable metrics. You will decide where AI agents and automation take over repetitive data work and where human judgment still matters, and partner with cross-functional teams to evaluate system changes that affect our data programs.

Who you are

  • Data obsessed and just as obsessed with removing manual work, with a habit of automating any process that relies on fixing records by hand
  • Curious about AI and a daily user, with experience shipping workflows with LLMs, agents, or AI-assisted tooling, and able to tell a useful application from a demo
  • Eager to build and shape a program rather than only maintain one, and able to create systems that hold up at global scale
  • Highly analytical, able to see the big picture and spot trends and gaps, then zoom in with practical, specific recommendations
  • Steady when juggling multiple priorities in a constantly changing environment
  • A good teammate, dedicated to the mission, who likes to have fun along the way

What you will do

  • Set the data governance strategy, standards, ownership model, and source-of-truth hierarchy for GTM data across Salesforce and connected systems
  • Establish policies, access controls, and field-level definitions, including record creation and deprecation rules, and monitor adherence
  • Ensure compliance and security of our data, and flag risks to IT, security, and leadership
  • Replace high-volume manual tasks (deduplication, enrichment, account matching, hierarchy mapping, routing, anomaly review) with automated and AI-assisted workflows
  • Design and maintain AI agents and LLM-powered workflows that classify, enrich, validate, and remediate data, with guardrails, human review points, and accuracy measurement
  • Build automated data quality monitoring that detects issues early, alerts the right owner, and fixes them without human intervention where appropriate
  • Evaluate and select AI, enrichment, and automation tooling, run pilots, and measure impact through time saved, accuracy gains, and coverage
  • Own the enrichment strategy and keep account firmographics accurate: hierarchies, employee count, location, industry, and Fortune ranking
  • Act as the subject matter expert for Business Ops, Marketing Ops, Customer Success, and Finance, run a defined feedback intake process, and support consistent reporting and dashboards
  • Manage a portfolio of data quality and automation projects with clear priorities, owners, and outcomes

Must Haves

  • 5+ years in Sales Operations, Data Operations, or a similar analytical or systems role
  • Hands-on experience building automation with AI or LLM tools (agents, prompt-driven workflows, AI-assisted enrichment), with shipped examples you can easily share
  • Strong understanding of data lifecycle management, data modeling, master data management, and requirements gathering
  • Demonstrated understanding of Salesforce automation, including Flow and validation rules, and experience working closely with admins
  • Experience implementing and managing data and enrichment tools, including AI-native tools such as Clay, Kernel, Starbridge, and Onfire
  • Proficiency in Excel
  • Track record of leading data management projects from idea to result
  • Sound judgment about where AI is reliable and where it needs controls for privacy, security, and accuracy
  • Detail oriented, self-motivated, proactive, and quick to learn new tools
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical and AI concepts to non-technical partners
  • Preferred: experience with workflow automation or integration platforms (such as Workato or Zapier), modern data stack tools (such as Snowflake or dbt), SQL, and a high-growth SaaS or security company

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

BeyondTrustâs Field Operations team sits at the center of how the company plans, forecasts, and executes revenue. We are building a team that operates with the analytic rigor of a finance org and the speed of a sales floor â and we need operators who can do both.

The Senior Sales Operations Analyst is a high-visibility individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Sales Operations. You will own the analytic backbone of our GTM motion: building the models, reports, and processes that sales leadership relies on to call the business, allocate resources, and drive execution across seven global theatres. Your work will span pipeline analytics and conversion trends, revenue planning and capacity modeling, and quota and territory design. Â You will be the person who turns raw Salesforce and Databricks data into forward-looking indicators that change how leaders make decisions â and you will partner closely with our GTM Engineer to operationalize AI-driven workflows that make the entire sales org faster and more precise.

This is not a back-office reporting role. Your analysis will show up in CRO forecast calls, board materials, and strategic planning sessions. If you want a seat where your work directly shapes how a high-growth cybersecurity company runs its revenue engine, this is it.

What Youâll Do

  • Pipeline Analytics & Forecasting: Deliver data-driven insights and forward-looking indicators for continuous improvement of sales forecasts, rep efficiency analytics, opportunity pipeline analysis, and conversion trends.
  • Revenue Planning & Modeling: Build bottom-up plans, capacity models, quota frameworks, and scenario analyses to improve forecast accuracy and planning confidence.
  • Process Design & Automation: Improve revenue execution by scaling reporting, reducing manual friction, and strengthening transparency across quotas, compensation, and strategic growth programs.
  • Territory & Segmentation Analysis: Build and maintain territory models that balance rep capacity, account coverage, and market opportunity â supporting annual planning and in-cycle territory realignments.
  • Standard Operating Procedures: Manage, document, and continuously improve the standard operating procedures that support the GTM motion â ensuring operational knowledge is codified and not trapped in any single person.
  • Data Integrity: Identify and lead data cleanup and enrichment projects that keep Salesforce and downstream reporting systems trustworthy and audit-ready.
  • AI Workflow Operationalization: Partner with the GTM Engineer to test, validate, and operationalize AI skills and automations â serving as the voice of the field to ensure new tooling fits real seller workflows.
  • Strategic Initiatives: Lead and own special initiatives and ad hoc requests from sales leadership â the kind of work that doesnât fit in a standing process but needs to be right and fast.
  • Trends & Reporting: Surface trends, risks, and wins using both quantitative and qualitative analysis â building the narrative around the numbers, not just the numbers themselves.

What Youâll Bring

Required

  • Minimum of 3 yearsâ experience as an Analyst in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Strategy roles in B2B SaaS or enterprise software environments.
  • Proficiency in BI tools (Power BI, Tableau), SQL, CRM platforms (Salesforce strongly preferred), and Excel modeling â you build the reports leadership actually uses.
  • Established business acumen with deep understanding of sales cycles, pipeline mechanics, marketing funnels, and forecasting processes.
  • Proven experience in sales performance analytics and planning, including territory design, quota management, revenue forecasting, and GTM capacity planning.
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills â comfortable taking ambiguous requests from Sales, Marketing, and RevOps stakeholders, translating them into delivered analysis, and framing technical work as business impact for executive audiences.
  • Track record of delivering accurate, audit-ready analysis under deadline pressure â the kind of work that goes to the CRO without a second pass.
  • Highly organized self-starter with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive work forward without waiting to be asked.

Preferred

  • Experience building and maintaining executive-ready reporting packages â QBR decks, board slides, forecast summaries â not just dashboards but the narrative around them.
  • Familiarity with revenue intelligence platforms (Clari, Gong, or similar) and how they integrate into a Salesforce-based GTM data model.
  • Comfort working with large datasets in Databricks, Snowflake, or similar platforms beyond basic Excel and BI tool work.
  • Working knowledge of automation tools and AI/ML fundamentals â you donât need to build the models, but you understand how to leverage them in operational workflows.
  • Background in cybersecurity or identity security markets.

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. Theyâre more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers whoÂ come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilegeâ¢. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com.Â

About the Role

Abnormal is built to look and feel like nothing else in security: precision-engineered, a little rebellious, and a few steps ahead of now. We protect more than 5,000 customers, including 30% of the Fortune 500, with a platform that stops the attacks everyone else misses. We need someone to make it look like the future it is.

We're looking for an Art Director who is first and foremost an artist. This is not a creative production role. You will own Abnormal's aesthetic direction, a singular visual identity with a bold and cinematic sensibility, and communicate that vision clearly to every team, vendor, and collaborator who executes creative work. You'll work closely with our CEO, CMO, VP of Product Marketing, and VP of Revenue Marketing to internalize Abnormal's worldview, then make it your own, ideally pushing it further than we imagined.

This role is distinct from our creative services function, which runs the production engine. Your job is to set the vision, protect its integrity, and elevate it. At Abnormal, you'll do the most exciting work of your career because you'll be shaping how the future of cybersecurity is seen, in a company where AI is at the core of the product and the way we work.

The ideal candidate is a concept artist at heart, someone who has spent their career in sci-fi film, cyberpunk or sci-fi video games, or similarly high-craft visual storytelling environments. Specifically, we want someone who knows how to design computer interfaces, holograms, and imagined future worlds, with the kind of detail that maps to a visionary technology company and its products: the in-world UI of a sci-fi game or film, the readout on a futuristic digital weapon, the menu architecture of a spacecraft. Not characters. Not atmospheric environments. Designed systems and objects with detail and intention. You see and express vision. You don't just execute.

What You Will Do

  • Define and own Abnormal's visual aesthetic direction
  • Lead visual ideation for high-stakes moments: major product launches, experiential events (RSA, Black Hat), and brand campaigns
  • Contribute hands-on concept work when the moment demands it. This is a vision-first role, but your craft should be evident
  • Build a shared creative language across the org so the aesthetic direction scales without bottlenecking through you
  • Serve as the creative authority and taste-setter for all visual output, from brand identity to campaigns to experiential environments
  • Translate the CEO's and leadership's vision into a clear, communicable aesthetic that others can execute without needing you in every room
  • Partner with creative services to keep production output style-consistent, setting guardrails and reviewing work rather than running the factory
  • Develop mood boards, concept art, and visual references that define "in the zone" creative for recruiter screening, vendor briefs, and internal alignment

Must Haves

  • 10+ years of experience in concept art, visual design, or art direction, with a body of work that shows artistic progression and a distinct point of view
  • Shipped credits on AAA game titles, major film productions, or equivalent high-craft visual projects in sci-fi, cyberpunk, or adjacent genres, with work focused on interface design, in-world UI/UX, holographic displays, or designed objects (virtual weapons, vehicles, technology systems) rather than characters, creatures, or natural environments
  • A portfolio that demonstrates genuine aesthetic vision, not just execution. Your work should show world-building expressed through designed objects and systems: architecture, vehicles, digital weapons, futuristic technology, UI. Detailed, intentional, engineered creative work. Painterly or landscape-driven portfolios are not the profile we're hiring
  • Experience as the sole or lead visual voice on at least one significant project: not just a contributor, but the person who owned the aesthetic direction end to end
  • Ability to articulate and document a visual language clearly enough that others can execute it without you present
  • Experience collaborating directly with senior leadership or creative directors and translating their vision into something tangible
  • Craft fluency across visual mediums: digital, environmental, editorial, motion
  • Proven ability to work as an individual contributor in a fast-moving tech company. You operate with autonomy, take feedback, and collaborate cross-functionally. You want to stay close to the work, and you're here to bring the vision, not manage a team
  • Strong communication and presentation skills. You can defend and sell a creative direction with clarity and confidence

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in B2B tech, cybersecurity, or enterprise software, or a demonstrated ability to quickly internalize a technical domain and translate it visually
  • Familiarity with experiential or event design (large-format, spatial, environmental)
  • Experience working alongside or managing a creative production team
  • Comfort with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools
